# Work out if you have to pay super
## When super guarantee is required
- Employee age – for employees who are
  - [under 18 years old](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/work-out-if-you-have-to-pay-super#Employeesagedunder18), you pay super if they work more than 30 hours in a week.

## Employees under 18
Employees under 18 years old are eligible for super guarantee if they work for you for more than 30 hours in a week, regardless of how much you pay them.

### Example: under 18 years old and working different hours a week
- more than 30 hours in one week in the hardware store, this employer pays her super guarantee for this week

## Domestic or private workers
Domestic or private workers are eligible for super guarantee if they work for you for more than 30 hours in a week, regardless of how much you pay them.

web.title: What payments are qualifying earnings | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# What payments are qualifying earnings
## Payments that are not qualifying earnings
- [payments to employees under 18 and domestic or private workers](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/paying-super-on-payday/what-payments-are-qualifying-earnings#Employeesunder18anddomesticorpriva) unless they work more than 30 hours in a week

### Employees under 18 and domestic or private workers
You do not need to pay super guarantee on payments to an employee who is under 18 years old, or a private or domestic worker, in any week where the employee or worker doesn't work more than 30 hours.

web.description:
# Module 2: Working out if you have to pay quarterly super
## Who is eligible for super guarantee
### Employees under 18
From 1 July 2022, you must pay SG on payments you make to these employees if they work for you more than 30 hours in a week.

- they worked for you more than 30 hours in a week

### Domestic workers
- From 1 July 2022
  - they work for you more than 30 hours in a week, regardless of how much you pay them.
- Prior to 1 July 2022
  - they work for you more than 30 hours in a week, and

## Summary of Module 2
- From 1 July 2022, for employees under 18 years old, you must pay super guarantee if they work more than 30 hours in a week
- You generally need to pay super guarantee if your employee is a private or domestic worker and works more than 30 hours per week regardless of how much you pay them.
